SELECT 
  (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int as auto_count,
  (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int as bike_count,
  (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int as motor_count,
  (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int + 
  (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int + 
  (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int as total_vehicles
FROM transportation_assets 
ORDER BY total_vehicles DESC 
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  CASE WHEN total_vehicles <= 1 THEN '0-1'
       WHEN total_vehicles <= 3 THEN '2-3'
       WHEN total_vehicles <= 5 THEN '4-5'
       ELSE '6+' END as vehicle_category,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int + 
    (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int + 
    (vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int as total_vehicles
  FROM transportation_assets
) sub
GROUP BY vehicle_category
ORDER BY vehicle_category;
